about:
KCCableCo Inc operates from Olathe, Kansas, serving the greater Kansas City metropolitan area. The company was established over a decade ago and has built a reputation for low‑voltage and structured cabling solutions across new construction and existing buildings.

The firm specializes in structured cabling using Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6e, fiber optic, and coaxial cables, all installed by BICSI‑certified technicians and backed by a one‑year workmanship warranty and up to a 20‑year manufacturer warranty. Its service portfolio also includes video security system installation and monitoring, access control design‑build for offices, medical facilities, schools, and apartment complexes, enterprise wireless design and support, sound masking, IT equipment installation, and IT smart‑hands support.

KCCableCo serves multi‑family residential, retail, medical, industrial, and commercial clients. Notable customers include managed service provider FireFly MSP, construction firm Lockmann Krane, electrical contractor Lightning Electric, manufacturer Stouse Manufacturing, and restaurant group PB&J Restaurant Group.

The company emphasizes that its differentiator lies in highly skilled BICSI‑certified staff who deliver cost‑effective, efficient solutions tailored to each project’s needs and budget, supported by a track record of high integrity, quality workmanship, and prompt responsiveness.
